submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One native 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body game sprite, water dragon scholar boy, screen LEFT. Image1 edit target, image2 definitive identity, image3 approved PRIMARY painting style.
Target WEST initial impact frame01/06. Keep the mostly upright grounded stance, same head size, same two boot locations/toes LEFT. Draw the very start of impact from screen LEFT: shoulders tighten slightly, pelvis/head lower only 1% through slight knee flexion, torso stays nearly upright (no backward recoil yet). Large blue eye opens wider in surprise, eyebrow rises, mouth just opens. Far RIGHT elbow begins drawing the open fan inward a little, hand gripping exactly the same hinge. Near LEFT EMPTY arm lifts from hanging to a modest bend at waist, fingers partly open. Keep exactly the same near empty hand and far fan hand ownership. Cloth/tassel motion is just beginning, modest, not sweeping dramatically.
Preserve navy straight hair/small ponytail, turquoise/gold hair ornament, blue tassels, blue/ivory/gold wave-cloud scholar robe, one ivory-blue water-dragon fan, jade on near LEFT hip. Exactly two arms/hands/legs/boots. Match bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand painting and fine materials. True transparent alpha, full body margin, no text/UI/ground/shadow/effects/particles/blur. Never mirror or swap ownership.
